meta.subject: Board review of Q4 performance and the FY27 plan

slides.title: Q4 revenue and retention review
slides.subtitle: What changed this quarter, what it means, and the plan we are asking the board to endorse.
slides.notes: Open by framing the decision: endorse the FY27 plan and the retention investment. Keep the opening under 90 seconds.

slides.title: Executive summary

bullets.text: Net revenue grew 18% year over year to $42.6M, driven by enterprise expansion.
Gross retention held at 94% while net retention reached 112%.
Two segments missed plan: SMB acquisition and partner-led deals in EMEA.
The FY27 plan reallocates 22% of acquisition spend to expansion and partner enablement.

slides.notes: This is the only slide some board members will read in the pre-read. Keep it to four lines.

slides.title: Where growth came from

image.alt: Bar chart illustration showing six quarters of accelerating revenue with a trend line

bullets.text: Expansion revenue contributed 61% of net new revenue.
Enterprise seat growth outpaced new-logo growth by 3:1.
Partner-sourced pipeline converted at 27%, below the 35% target.

slides.caption: Illustrative trend, not to scale.
slides.notes: Explain the shift from acquisition-led to expansion-led growth.

slides.title: Customer voice
slides.quote: The upgrade path was obvious once we saw usage across teams. That is why we consolidated two vendors into one.
slides.notes: Anonymised quote approved by the customer success team in October.

slides.title: What worked and what to change

bullets.text: Expansion plays mapped to product usage signals
Enterprise onboarding with a named success manager
SMB self-serve funnel needs a pricing test before scale
Partner enablement is under-resourced in EMEA
Renewal forecasting moves from spreadsheet to system of record

slides.notes: Balance the two columns: this is not a defence of the quarter.

slides.title: FY27 plan
slides.subtitle: Reallocate 22% of acquisition spend to expansion and partner enablement
slides.notes: Transition: from evidence to what we are asking for.

slides.title: FY27 priorities

bullets.text: Grow net retention from 112% to 118% by shifting 22% of acquisition spend into expansion.
Rebuild partner enablement in EMEA with two regional leads and a certification path.
Run a pricing test for SMB self-serve in two markets before any headcount increase.
Hold gross retention at or above 94% while the expansion motion scales.

slides.notes: The ask: approve the reallocation, not new budget.

slides.title: Retention trajectory under the FY27 plan
slides.caption: Plan case assumes expansion plays land as scheduled in Q1.
slides.notes: If expansion slips a quarter, net retention lands at 116%, not 118%.
